assets.label: Right-side house
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Transparent premium residential house asset for web composition
Primary request: Use the reference crop only as style and subject guidance. Generate a brand-new standalone transparent WebP-ready asset: the large right-side luxury residential house from the Fairlend composite, rendered as a premium 3D miniature real-estate model. Include the dark charcoal mansard-style roof, dormer windows with warm interior glow, cream stone/brick facade, front porch, steps, railings, soft landscaping, rounded trees/shrubs, paved walkway/driveway, and the small matching right-side garden-suite/outbuilding only if it naturally fits the composition. Preserve the warm sunset/studio lighting, soft shadows, shallow isometric camera angle, upscale residential finance mood, and polished landing-page realism. Isolate only the house scene on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background for alpha removal, with generous padding and crisp edges.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: Do not include screenshot pixels, map grid, city labels, Toronto skyline, CN Tower, red route line, red pin, goal card, UI cards, text, icons, buttons, Fairlend logo, page background, watermark, border, or mobile screenshot chrome.
